about: 2026/27 income tax (England, Wales and Northern Ireland) and employee National Insurance (Class 1), for take-home pay (src/sim/household.js). Income tax bands are widths of taxable income after the personal allowance; the allowance taper (£1 lost for every £2 of income over £100,000) is in the code's rule, not used at £75k. Scotland's bands are not modelled.
source: Income tax: gov.uk 'Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances' (2026/27 rates); cross-checked on litrg.org.uk and moneytothemasses.com. NI: gov.uk 'Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027' (employee rates); cross-checked on litrg.org.uk.
